title: How heat attacks the body
description:
Hour by hour: how a heat wave pushes your body from sweating to heat stroke.
#heatwave #summer #science #body
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.

music.credit: Music: "Cut and Run" - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0

lines.hook: What happens to your body in a heat wave?
lines.b1: After an hour, you sweat buckets to cool your body down.
lines.b2: After three hours, your heart pumps harder to push heat out through your skin.
lines.b3: After five hours, you feel dizzy and sick. That's heat exhaustion.
lines.b4: By hour six, your core can hit forty degrees, and your brain gets confused.
lines.b5: After seven hours, heat stroke can strike, and you may stop sweating.
lines.end: Stay cool out there. Where's the hottest place you've been?
